set.body: The parity-gated side-256 directional comparison measured full reductions at 0.069x-0.097x NumPy speed and axis reductions at 0.229x-0.329x. Profile dtype dispatch, loop planning, vectorization, and axis traversal. Acceptance: preserve reduction laws and edge semantics, add allocation/structure evidence, and confirm gains with the full two-size benchmark protocol.
set.title: Profile and optimize reduction kernels against NumPy
